structuralFindings: Rates are quoted PER UNIT PER NIGHT (i.e. per suite/villa, not per person) — a different unit from most properties in this batch (Lantana, Leopard Beach, Manda Bay are per-person; Lion in the Sun's Lion rooms and Medina share the per-unit convention).
Base rate basis is 'accommodation and breakfast' (i.e. Bed & Breakfast) — confirmed explicitly in the source subtitle.
Three seasons: Green, High, Peak — note Green here is the LOWEST-priced season name (opposite of how 'Green Season' sometimes implies a discount tier elsewhere; just a season label, not a rate tier).

High Season is itself split into two separate date windows with different minimum-stay rules embedded (6 Jan-28 Feb & 3-6 Apr = min 2 nights; 1-31 Aug & 20-26 Dec = min 3 nights) — both charged at the same High Season rate despite different minimum-stay rules.
Six accommodation categories scaling from 1BR (2 guests) to 4BR Ocean Villa (8 guests) — full range extracted.

A SEPARATE 'Meal Supplement 2026' document exists for adding Half Board or Full Board on top of the B&B base rate — priced per person per night in FOUR currencies (KSH/USD/EUR/GBP) and FOUR rate columns (Green/High/Peak/New Year's Eve). New Year's Eve (31 Dec) is its own single-night surcharge column, separate from the Peak season window.

Meal supplement child policy: ages 3-11.99 charged 50% of the supplement; 12+ considered adult. Different bracket again from Lantana (4-12), Leopard Beach (2-13.9), Manda Bay (5-17), Malindi Retreat (6-12) — every coastal property checked so far uses its own distinct child-age bracket.
Meal supplement rate is locked at time of reservation, non-transferable day-to-day, non-commissionable, and movement between meal plans mid-stay is not allowed.

Peak Season here has a distinct, stricter cancellation policy (40% fee 21-60 days out, 100% within 21 days) vs the standard policy (full refund >120 days, deposit forfeited 30-120 days, 40% fee 10-30 days, 100% within 10 days).
